name: Gokulam
description: Gokulam is a quiet, upmarket residential area in northwest Mysore known worldwide as the ashtanga yoga district. It offers cafes, health food spots, yoga shalas, coworking-friendly cafes and long-stay apartments popular with visiting practitioners and remote workers.
bestFor: Yoga students, long-stay nomads wanting a quiet residential base

name: Jayalakshmipuram (JLB)
description: Jayalakshmipuram, often called JLB, is a well-planned residential neighbourhood near the university and Kukkarahalli Lake. It has cafes, bakeries, quiet tree-lined streets and modern apartments, making it a comfortable middle ground between Gokulam and the busy centre.
bestFor: Remote workers wanting calm streets, cafes and lake walks nearby

name: City Centre (Around Mysore Palace)
tagline: Heart of the city and markets
description: The central area around Mysore Palace and Devaraja Market is the busy commercial and tourist core. It holds heritage hotels, the illuminated palace, silk and sandalwood shops, Sayyaji Rao Road and Devaraja Urs Road, plus the main bus and rail stations nearby.
bestFor: Short-stay travellers wanting sights, shopping and transport at hand

name: Vijayanagar
description: Vijayanagar is a large, newer planned residential area on the western side of Mysore, organised into numbered stages. It offers modern apartments, malls, supermarkets and restaurants, appealing to longer-stay visitors who prefer contemporary conveniences over old-city character.
bestFor: Long-stay visitors wanting modern flats, malls and everyday convenience
